title: ADA Analyte-Column Specification Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification analyte-column definitions derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Each $def constrains one analyte-table reporting column (e.g. detectionLimit, xrayEmissionLine). TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs (schema.yaml#/$defs/<name>) so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.

backgroundCorrectionMethod.title: Background Correction Method
backgroundCorrectionMethod.description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak.

backgroundCountingPosition.title: Typical Background Position(s)
backgroundCountingPosition.description: Positions of background measurements relative to the peak, in mm and/or sinθ, and whether on the high or low energy side.

backgroundCountingTime.title: Default Background Counting Time
backgroundCountingTime.description: Total time spent counting at background position(s) in seconds.

blankCorrection.title: Blank Correction
blankCorrection.description: Method and reference materials used to determine and apply blank corrections.

detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
detectionLimitMethod.description: Method used to compute detection limits.

edsDeadTime.title: EDS Dead Time
edsDeadTime.description: Percent dead time reported by the EDS spectrometer

elementEstimationMethod.title: Element Estimation Method
elementEstimationMethod.description: How elemental concentrations were calculated — directly from measured X-ray intensities or via cation stoichiometry.

empa_analyticalAccuracy.title: Analytical Accuracy
empa_analyticalAccuracy.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as percent relative bias. Include reference material, reference value source, and per-analyte value.

empa_analyticalPrecision.title: Analytical Precision
empa_analyticalPrecision.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent reference material, expressed as 1-sigma relative standard deviation (%). Include reference material name, number of analyses (n), and value per analyte or element group.

empa_backgroundPosition.title: Background Position(s)
empa_backgroundPosition.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

empa_beamCurrent.title: Beam Current
empa_beamCurrent.description: Probe current in nanoamperes (nA). Often varies by phase type or analyte; record the protocol-standard value(s).

empa_countingStatisticsError.title: Counting Statistics Error
empa_countingStatisticsError.description: 1-sigma uncertainty propagated from counting statistics on peak and background intensities for each analyte per analysis.

empa_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
empa_detectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence (3-sigma) for each analyte, derived from counting statistics on peak and background. Include the method and resulting value per analyte.

empa_diffractingCrystal.title: Diffracting Crystal
empa_diffractingCrystal.description: Analyzing crystal (monochromator) used in the WDS spectrometer for each analyte. Crystal choice determines the detectable wavelength range and dispersion.

empa_epmaTechniquePerAnalyte.title: EPMA Technique per Analyte
empa_epmaTechniquePerAnalyte.description: Whether each analyte was measured by WDS or EDS. In a WDS+EDS protocol, some elements may be assigned to WDS and others to EDS.

empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials to correct for session-to-session calibration drift.

empa_primaryCalibrationStandardName.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
empa_primaryCalibrationStandardName.description: Name(s) of the primary reference material(s) used for element standardization (intensity calibration).

empa_proportionalCounterDetector.title: Proportional Counter / Detector
empa_proportionalCounterDetector.description: Type of detector used in the WDS spectrometer for each analyte. Affects sensitivity and count rate linearity.

empa_secondaryReferenceMaterials.title: Secondary Reference Materials
empa_secondaryReferenceMaterials.description: Quality-control reference material(s) analyzed alongside unknowns to verify calibration accuracy. Include material name, assessed elements, number of analyses (n), and measured vs. accepted values.

empa_wdsPhaSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
empa_wdsPhaSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer (PHA) setting for the WDS detector. Integral mode accepts all pulses above a threshold; Differential mode selects a narrow energy window to reject higher-order reflections and escape peaks.

empa_wdsSpectrometerChannel.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
empa_wdsSpectrometerChannel.description: WDS spectrometer number assigned to each analyte. Different spectrometers may have different crystal configurations.

epmaTechnique.title: EPMA Technique per Element
epmaTechnique.description: Whether this element was measured by WDS or EDS.

geochron_analyticalAccuracyAndAssessment.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
geochron_analyticalAccuracyAndAssessment.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary reference materials. Table 3's validation weighted-average ages, compared against each material's independently accepted age (cited in Secondary Reference Materials above), serve as the accuracy statement for this worked example.

geochron_betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecisi.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
geochron_betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecisi.description: Reproducibility of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months. Not addressed in Table 3 of Horstwood et al. (2016), which reports only within-session validation results.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

geochron_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
geochron_detectionLimit.description: Session detection limit for U, Th, and/or Pb, demonstrating the reliability of reported concentrations near the detection limit. Not requested by Table 3 of Horstwood et al. (2016), which focuses on age uncertainty rather than elemental detection limits.

geochron_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
geochron_detectionLimitMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the session detection limit reported above.

geochron_interferenceCorrectionMethod.title: Interference Correction Method
geochron_interferenceCorrectionMethod.description: Equation or procedure used to correct for isobaric interferences, including the reference material or monitor isotope used to characterise it.

geochron_interferingSpecies.title: Interfering Species
geochron_interferingSpecies.description: Elemental or molecular species overlapping with the measured isotope, relevant to U-Th-Pb geochronology (e.g., ²⁰⁴Hg on ²⁰⁴Pb, relevant to the Common-Pb Correction field above).

geochron_isobaricInterferenceCorrections.title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
geochron_isobaricInterferenceCorrections.description: Whether isobaric interference corrections were applied for any measured isotope in this procedure. A procedure-level Boolean; element-specific detail is in Interfering Species and Interference Correction Method.

geochron_limitOfQuantificationMethod.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
geochron_limitOfQuantificationMethod.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification: the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy.

geochron_massResolutionPerAnalyte.title: Mass Resolution per Analyte
geochron_massResolutionPerAnalyte.description: Mass resolution mode assigned to each analyte in this procedure. The selected resolution determines which polyatomic interferences (e.g., ¹⁸⁶W¹⁶O⁺ on ²⁰²Hg, relevant to common-Pb correction) are physically resolved by the magnetic sector. Applicable only to sector-field instruments.

geochron_withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisio.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
geochron_withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisio.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements within a single analytical session. Assessment method specifies the reference material used, number of replicates n, and the statistic reported.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

interferenceCorrection.title: Interference Corrections Applied
interferenceCorrection.description: Flag indicating whether a spectral interference correction was applied for this element.

interferenceCorrectionStandard.title: Interference Correction Standard
interferenceCorrectionStandard.description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

interferingElements.title: Interfering Elements
interferingElements.description: List of elements whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured line for this element.

monochromatorCrystal.title: Diffracting Crystal
monochromatorCrystal.description: Analysing crystal (monochromator) used in the WDS spectrometer for this element.

normalization-standardsCorrection.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
normalization-standardsCorrection.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials.

peakCountingTime.title: Default Peak Counting Time
peakCountingTime.description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position in seconds.

primaryCalibrationStandard.title: Primary Calibration Standard Name
primaryCalibrationStandard.description: Primary reference material used for element standardization (calibration).

pulseHeightAnalyzeSetting.title: WDS PHA Setting
pulseHeightAnalyzeSetting.description: Pulse height analyzer setting used for the WDS detector.

secondaryReferenceMaterial.title: Secondary Reference Materials
secondaryReferenceMaterial.description: List of quality-control reference materials (secondary standards) routinely analyzed alongside unknowns.

semComposition_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
semComposition_detectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence for each analyte. Include the method used and the resulting value per analyte.

semComposition_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
semComposition_detectionLimitMethod.description: Formula or procedure used to calculate detection limits.

sem_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
sem_detectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence for each analyte. Include the method used and the resulting value per analyte.

sem_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
sem_detectionLimitMethod.description: Formula or procedure used to calculate detection limits.

solutionQicpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAsse.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
solutionQicpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAsse.description: Accuracy of final concentration measurements relative to certified or consensus values and the method used to assess it.

solutionQicpms_betweenSessionAnalyticalP.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionQicpms_betweenSessionAnalyticalP.description: Precision of measurements across multiple analysis sessions (long-term reproducibility) and the assessment method.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

solutionQicpms_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
solutionQicpms_detectionLimit.description: Elemental detection limits for each analyte. Specify units (µg/g or µg/L) and whether values are protocol-typical estimates or session-specific measured values.

solutionQicpms_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
solutionQicpms_detectionLimitMethod.description: Method used to calculate detection limits for each analyte.

solutionQicpms_dwellTimePerMass.title: Dwell Time per Mass
solutionQicpms_dwellTimePerMass.description: Integration time spent on each mass peak per sweep (ms). May differ per analyte if analyte-specific dwell times are programmed.

solutionQicpms_interferenceCorrectionMet.title: Interference Correction Method
solutionQicpms_interferenceCorrectionMet.description: Mathematical approach used to calculate and remove interference contributions from measured signals (e.g., interference standard solutions isolating specific polyatomics, mass-balance equations using empirical correction factors).

solutionQicpms_interferingSpecies.title: Interfering Species
solutionQicpms_interferingSpecies.description: List of isobaric or polyatomic species mathematically corrected in data reduction. Analyte-specific. For Q-ICP-MS, common interferences include ArCl+ on 75As, MoO+ species on Cd isotopes, and BaO+ on Eu. Additional interference mitigation via KED or DRC is documented in Group 3 and Group 4.

solutionQicpms_isobaricInterferenceCorre.title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
solutionQicpms_isobaricInterferenceCorre.description: Whether mathematical corrections for isobaric or polyatomic interferences are applied during data reduction (in addition to any KED or DRC mitigation in the instrument).

solutionQicpms_limitOfQuantificationMeth.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
solutionQicpms_limitOfQuantificationMeth.description: Method used to determine the limit of quantification.

solutionQicpms_monitoredIsotopes.title: Monitored Isotopes
solutionQicpms_monitoredIsotopes.description: Specific isotope(s) monitored per analyte element in this protocol, including any interference-monitor masses. Analyte-specific field.

solutionQicpms_withinSessionAnalyticalPr.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionQicpms_withinSessionAnalyticalPr.description: Precision of repeated measurements within a single analysis session and the method used to assess it (e.g., %RSD of replicate standard or reference material measurements).

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

solutionSficpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAss.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
solutionSficpms_analyticalAccuracyAndAss.description: Accuracy of final concentration measurements relative to certified or consensus values and the method used to assess it.

solutionSficpms_betweenSessionAnalytical.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionSficpms_betweenSessionAnalytical.description: Precision of measurements across multiple analysis sessions (long-term reproducibility) and the assessment method.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

solutionSficpms_detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
solutionSficpms_detectionLimit.description: Elemental detection limits for each analyte. Specify units (µg/g or µg/L) and whether values are protocol-typical estimates or session-specific measured values.

solutionSficpms_detectionLimitMethod.title: Detection Limit Method
solutionSficpms_detectionLimitMethod.description: Method used to calculate detection limits for each analyte.

solutionSficpms_dwellTimePerMass.title: Dwell Time per Mass
solutionSficpms_dwellTimePerMass.description: Integration time spent on each mass peak per sweep (ms). May differ per analyte if analyte-specific dwell times are programmed.

solutionSficpms_interferenceCorrectionMe.title: Interference Correction Method
solutionSficpms_interferenceCorrectionMe.description: Mathematical approach used to calculate and remove residual interference contributions from measured signals. In SF-ICP-MS, interference solutions isolating specific polyatomic species are measured alongside samples and used to calibrate correction factors.

solutionSficpms_interferingSpecies.title: Interfering Species
solutionSficpms_interferingSpecies.description: List of isobaric or polyatomic species mathematically corrected in data reduction. In SF-ICP-MS, mass resolution is the primary interference mitigation strategy; mathematical corrections address residual interferences not resolved at the operating resolution. Analyte-specific.

solutionSficpms_isobaricInterferenceCorr.title: Isobaric Interference Corrections Applied
solutionSficpms_isobaricInterferenceCorr.description: Whether mathematical corrections for residual isobaric or polyatomic interferences are applied in data reduction (supplementary to any interference suppression achieved through mass resolution selection).

solutionSficpms_limitOfQuantificationMet.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
solutionSficpms_limitOfQuantificationMet.description: Method used to determine the limit of quantification.

solutionSficpms_massResolutionPerAnalyte.title: Mass Resolution per Analyte
solutionSficpms_massResolutionPerAnalyte.description: Mass resolution mode assigned to each analyte in this protocol. The selected resolution determines which polyatomic interferences are physically resolved by the magnet sector. Per-analyte assignments are documented here; the overall mode(s) used in the protocol are recorded in Mass Resolution Setting (Group 3). Analyte-specific field.

solutionSficpms_monitoredIsotopes.title: Monitored Isotopes
solutionSficpms_monitoredIsotopes.description: Specific isotope(s) monitored per analyte element in this protocol, including any interference-monitor masses. Analyte-specific field.

solutionSficpms_withinSessionAnalyticalP.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionSficpms_withinSessionAnalyticalP.description: Precision of repeated measurements within a single analysis session and the method used to assess it (e.g., %RSD of replicate standard or reference material measurements).

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

spectrometerNumber.title: WDS Spectrometer Channel
spectrometerNumber.description: WDS spectrometer number used for this element.

timeDependentIntensityCorrection.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
timeDependentIntensityCorrection.description: Type of time-dependent intensity correction applied for volatile or beam-sensitive elements.

typicalAnalyticalAccuracy.title: Typical Analytical Accuracy
typicalAnalyticalAccuracy.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as % relative bias.

typicalAnalyticalPrecision.title: Typical Analytical Precision
typicalAnalyticalPrecision.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent standard, expressed as 1σ relative standard deviation (%).

typicalCountingStatisticsError.title: Typical Counting Statistics Error
typicalCountingStatisticsError.description: 1σ uncertainty propagated from counting statistics on peak and background intensities.

typicalDetectionLimit.title: Typical Detection Limit
typicalDetectionLimit.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence (3σ) for each measured element.

wdsDetectorType.title: Proportional Counter / Detector
wdsDetectorType.description: Type of detector used in the WDS spectrometer for this element.

xrayEmissionLine.title: X-ray Line
xrayEmissionLine.description: The X-ray emission line measured for this element.

detectionLimit.title: Detection Limit
detectionLimit.description: Session detection limit for each measured isotope, expressed in µg g⁻¹, ng g⁻¹, or wt% as appropriate. Report the value(s) and units per isotope or element group. Mandatory at analysis level to demonstrate the reliability of reported near-detection-limit concentrations. The calculation method is captured separately in Detection Limit Method.

limitOfQuantification.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
limitOfQuantification.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification (LOQ): the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy. Mandatory at analysis level when concentrations near the LOD are reported. Concentrations between LOD and LOQ are detectable but not reliably quantifiable.

withinSessionReproducibility.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
withinSessionReproducibility.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements within a single analytical session. Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Assessment method must specify: (1) the reference material used, (2) number of replicates n, and (3) the statistic reported (1σ RSD, 2σ RSD, etc.). For mapping: assess from repeated analyses of a reference material area at session start and end, or from replicate analyses of a homogeneous reference phase within the map.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

withinSessionReproducibilityMethod.title: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
withinSessionReproducibilityMethod.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements within a single analytical session. Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Assessment method must specify: (1) the reference material used, (2) number of replicates n, and (3) the statistic reported (1σ RSD, 2σ RSD, etc.). For mapping: assess from repeated analyses of a reference material area at session start and end, or from replicate analyses of a homogeneous reference phase within the map.

schema:name.const: Within-Session Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

betweenSessionReproducibility.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
betweenSessionReproducibility.description: Reproducibility of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months (long-term or intermediate precision). Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Specify: reference material used, number of sessions n, time span covered, and statistic reported. Long-term precision is typically assessed from a compiled record of secondary reference material values across all sessions.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

betweenSessionReproducibilityMethod.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
betweenSessionReproducibilityMethod.description: Reproducibility of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months (long-term or intermediate precision). Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Specify: reference material used, number of sessions n, time span covered, and statistic reported. Long-term precision is typically assessed from a compiled record of secondary reference material values across all sessions.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

analyticalAccuracy.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
analyticalAccuracy.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary reference materials, expressed as % relative bias. Report both the assessment method and the accuracy values. Specify: (1) secondary RM used and source of reference values, (2) number of analyses, and (3) elements or element groups assessed. Report any systematic biases and likely causes.

analyticalAccuracyMethod.title: Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Method
analyticalAccuracyMethod.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary reference materials, expressed as % relative bias. Report both the assessment method and the accuracy values. Specify: (1) secondary RM used and source of reference values, (2) number of analyses, and (3) elements or element groups assessed. Report any systematic biases and likely causes.
